#!/bin/bash

if [ -z "$1" ]; then
    echo "Usage: count <directory>"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$1" ]; then
    echo "Error: '$1' is not a directory"
    exit 1
fi

# Count regular files (not symlinks)
regular_count=$(find "$1" -type f | wc -l)

# Count symlinks separately
link_count=$(find "$1" -type l | wc -l)

# Display regular file count
echo "$regular_count"

# If there are links, display the link count
if [ "$link_count" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "$link_count"
fi
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/count
